scope: SM86 native cooperative Q4 fused gate/up, T4 K5120 N17408, literal packed half2 Q8 metadata
hypothesis: Stage the 23040-byte packed Q8 input once per existing persistent CTA, then replace repeated global input loads by bank-swizzled shared loads across native grid-stride rows. Weight loads and ordered arithmetic remain native.

cost_filter.risk: The baseline input is already cache-hot; shared occupancy consumes L1 capacity and shared loads retain the input LSU work.
cost_filter.scope_of_bound: CPU sensitivity calculation over an existing instrumented RU4089/512 capture; not client-wall or JSON32K prediction

compile_kill_rules: A source pin or reversible transform fails.
The actual native and OFF kernel machine text differs.
More than 128 registers, any stack/local memory/spill, or fewer than four CTA per documented SM86 resource bound.
A new CTA barrier appears inside the row or K loop.
Manual SASS review cannot establish input LDG only before rows, shared code/metadata loads inside rows, unchanged weight loads and ordered arithmetic. Histogram equality alone never passes this gate.
Actual CUDA occupancy does not admit four CTA with the candidate launch dynamic shared bytes when a runtime harness is later authorized.
future_usefulness_kill_rule: Only after resource/manual mechanism and exact/oracle gates: a short fixed balanced pack+fused region screen should reduce time by at least 6 percent with all blocks positive. Otherwise stop before runtime integration or CI.
